status: pre-registered; NOT run (paid model calls need explicit authorization)
question: Does Stack-Agent's adaptive context (auto) use fewer provider-reported input tokens than the legacy request (replay) without losing correctness, recovery or verification?

stages.purpose: harder reasoning, recovery and context quality, durable state on
stages.gate: only after course-000 shows no correctness regression in auto

order: alternating ABBA within each stage (replay, auto, auto, replay, ...), one run at a time
excluded: process-interruption obstacles: the 6-minute lease wait is a separate PR (lease heartbeat) and would dominate elapsed time
prompt-cache off/on crossing: a possible follow-up once replay vs auto is understood
record: evaluator outcome, hidden acceptance and regression results (authoritative)
provider-reported input, output, cache-read and cache-write tokens (unknown stays null, never 0)
model calls, tool executions, rejected replies
context profile per call, selection reasons and transitions
recovery of the injected obstacle and whether it was recognized
Stack-Agent completion section (model claim, change, tests, verification)

decisionRule.correctness: auto must not lose a PASS that replay gets on the same stage; any auto-only FAIL is a regression to investigate before more spend
decisionRule.efficiency: a reduction in median provider-reported total input tokens (input + cache read + cache write) per PASS run, consistent across runs, not driven by one outlier
decisionRule.reliability: no worse completion/verification accuracy against the evaluator, and no worse obstacle recovery
decisionRule.evidence: 5 + 3 runs per arm is an initial screen: if correctness is equal and the token ranges overlap, the result is reported as INCONCLUSIVE and the experiment is NOT expanded automatically

pricingUsdPerMTok.note: cacheWrite assumes the 5-minute TTL at 1.25x input; check current Anthropic pricing before approving

baseline.source: Agent Obstacle Course batch 2026-10-28 (stack-agent 35d7af2, no prompt caching, --no-state on T4)

metrics.primary: total input tokens per run = provider-reported uncached input + cache read + cache write (cached input counts as input; a fall in the uncached portion alone is not an input-token reduction)
secondary: actual cost from provider-reported token categories at the listed prices (reported separately from token volume)
hardConstraints: Stack-Agent completion/verification status, reported alongside the evaluator result and never replaced by it (keep both signals; note any escalated-but-PASS runs)

stopRule: strict: 3 runs per arm on T4, then stop and report; mixed or noisy results lead to trace diagnosis, not a larger sample

amendments.change: added explicit primary/secondary metrics, hard constraints and the strict stop rule; primary objective unchanged; course-000 results unchanged
amendments.timing: made about 25 s after the T4 runs were admitted (first admitted 01:42:17Z) and before any T4 result was available; recorded data is unaffected
